usage: Used as a hobby noun for building or assembling model kits, especially plastic or scale models.
Common with verbs like『砌』,『玩』,『買』, and『整』to talk about doing the hobby or getting materials.
Can refer to the finished model or the whole hobby activity, depending on context.
Sounds natural in everyday Cantonese; for beginners, it usually means hobby models rather than computer or mathematical models.
